newsitem.title: MEXICO: Dina says has accord to sell buses.
newsitem.headline: Dina says has accord to sell buses.

text.p: Mexican busmaker Grupo Dina said on Thursday it formed a strategic alliance with a firm that recently won a Mexico City public transport concession and will sell it 385 buses.

The alliance was struck by Dina, in conjunction with its U.S. subsidiary Motor Coach Industries International Inc and Mexican firm Transportes y Servicios Terrestres G SA de CV, which won a concession to operate 25 bus routes in southern Mexico City.
Dina said 358 of the buses would be used for regular service and 27 for express and executive services.
